related_questions.question: Is it safe to go to Crete now?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it is generally safe to travel to Crete. The Foreign Office does not advise against non-essential travel to the region. While Crete is generally safe, it's always wise to exercise normal precautions as you would in any travel destination.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, it is generally safe to travel to Crete

list.title: Crime:
list.snippet: Crime rates are low, and travelers should not be overly concerned about crime. However, petty theft like pickpocketing can occur in crowded tourist areas, so it's important to be aware of your belongings.

list.title: Earthquakes:
list.snippet: Greece, including Crete, is in an earthquake-prone area. While there have been recent earthquakes, they haven't caused significant disruptions for tourists.

list.title: Wildfires:
list.snippet: Crete is at high risk of wildfires during the summer months (April to October). Tourists should be aware of fire warnings and follow local guidance.

list.title: Health:
list.snippet: No special vaccinations are required, but it's always recommended to have routine vaccinations up to date. Staying hydrated, using sunscreen, and being aware of seasonal allergies are also important.

list.title: Other dangers:
list.snippet: Be aware of strong currents and riptides when swimming in the sea, and be cautious of potential hazards like coral, urchins, and jellyfish.

list.title: Stay informed:
list.snippet: Check for any travel advisories or updates from your government's travel website or the Greek government.

list.title: Register for emergency alerts:
list.snippet: Ensure your mobile phone is registered to receive emergency alerts for wildfire warnings.

list.title: Be aware of your surroundings:
list.snippet: Take precautions against petty theft and be mindful of your belongings.

list.title: Follow local guidance:
list.snippet: Pay attention to any instructions or warnings from local authorities regarding safety issues like wildfires or earthquakes.

list.title: Consider travel insurance:
list.snippet: It's always a good idea to have travel insurance that covers medical expenses and potential disruptions.
